description: This file defines the TestBase class, which provides methods for managing, launching, and testing task hierarchies in an Android application, specifically by constructing and starting activity stacks using various approaches.

classes.name: TestBase
classes.description: A utility class to build, manage, and launch Android activity task stacks for testing purposes.

methods.name: TestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TestBase with a context and a hierarchy of nodes representing activities and tasks.

methods.name: startActivities
methods.description: Launches the activity stacks using specified styles: via command line, task stack builder, or forward launch sequence.

methods.name: setActivities
methods.description: Builds task stacks based on a hierarchy of nodes, each representing a set of activities.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current Android Context associated with this TestBase.
